25
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, November 28, 2011/Agrahayana 7, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Corporate
Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines; Minority Affairs;
New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary Affairs; Power;
Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Improvement in conditions
of Muslims
*81. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI : Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Sachar Committee
Report has raised concerns that though
there is considerable variation in the
conditions of Muslims across States, the
community exhibits deficits and
deprivation in practically all dimensions of
development;
(b) if so, the steps Government is
taking to improve the conditions of
Muslims in the States where the situation
is worse; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
comply with the recommendations of the
Sachar Committee?
Distribution of food subsidy
†*82. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that distribution
of food subsidy is not being effected
uniformly by the Central Government in
accordance with the BPL population in the
States;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details thereof?
Power situation
*83. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) the power generation from various
sources, source-wise alongwith the demand
and supply of power in the country at
present, State/UT-wise;
(b) the details of the power projects
commissioned during the last three years

26
and the current year, project-wise and State-
wise;
(c) whether the demand of power has
been continuously increasing;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
step up the power generation capacity in
consonance with the rise in demand of
power?
Study of earth sciences
*84. SHRI TARUN VIJAY: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) the measures Government has taken
to popularise the study of earth sciences
amongst the youths in colleges;
(b) whether Government is
contemplating any special scheme to attract
young scientists towards this stream; and
(c) the number of doctorates awarded
by various universities in the field of earth
sciences during the last three years?
Plan to bring back Indian scientists
*85. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of  SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has drawn any
plan to attract and bring back Indian
scientists working abroad to pursue
scientific research in the country in their
respective fields of work;
(b) if so, the details including the cost
thereof; and
(c) the steps taken so far in this
direction?
Shortage of coal in thermal power
plants in Punjab
*86. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: W ill the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether there was an acute shortage
of coal in the thermal power plants in
Punjab due to which the plants could not
operate at their optimum capacity; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
remedial measures taken to avoid the
recurrence of such shortage?
Production of coal by private sector
companies
†*87. SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in order to
enhance coal production in the country,
Government had entrusted private sector
with the responsibility  of producing coal
by allocating them coal blocks;
(b) if so, the number of such coal blocks
that had come under the control of the
private sector till September, 2011, and the
number of coal blocks wherein coal
production had started; and
(c) the target fixed for coal production
and the actual quantity of coal produced
by the private sector upto September, 2011?
Consolidation of small mines
*88. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
diverse representations on the proposed
Mining Bill;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

27
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to close all small mines in the
country and consolidate them for
exploitation by large firms;
(c) whether Government is forming a
separate body to oversee such
consolidation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Price rise of essential food items
*89. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of rise in prices of
essential food items during the last three
months, item-wise and month-wise;
(b) whether food inflation has again
surged and has reached double digit in the
month of October, 2011;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
